decision: Approve the art director's preferred source for every ordinary-animal friend generated through and including Red Panda. Later species remain pending.
selectionBasis: Best recognition, expression and silhouette at the 96 px proof scale; source-resolution finish remained acceptable.
approvalMeaning: The selected sources may proceed through deterministic transparent-derivative QA and later family publication. This does not itself switch runtime catalogue pointers or retire old art.
